releases.body:
## v0.4.0

- **Generic `webhook` action** — replaces the TypeWhisper-specific integration. A button can now fire an arbitrary HTTP request on press and (optionally) on release, so any local API (TypeWhisper, OBS, VLC, ...) can be driven without the app hardcoding a third-party tool.
- **Mapping editor fixes** — the webhook editor no longer overflows the screen; a stale `[data-role="port"]` selector that broke conditional field visibility was fixed; an invalid webhook (no url) is no longer persisted.
- **Scan-code fix** — output keys now carry real scan codes via `MapVirtualKeyW`, fixing a stuck-key issue with apps that filter injected input.
- Plugin (`rebind-me`) bumped to 0.4.0 to match the Python package.
